name: engine-identity
summary: Inherit identity only with whole-commit ownership
body:
Splitting a trailer-bearing commit into two nodes stamped the SAME
Isomer-Change id on both halves — the very next inspect flagged
duplicate_id on ism's own output and the change metadata was
clobbered last-writer-wins. A node now inherits identity only when
it owns every hunk of its single source commit (and never an id
another node claims explicitly). Also: an explicit-base apply no
longer clobbers the recorded trunk with an empty string, and a
failed void append no longer masks the E101 the caller must see.
